abstract: PURPOSE: To assess the diagnostic accuracy of a new automatic texture-based algorithm (ATBA) in ultrasound imaging of ovarian masses and to compare its performance to subjective assessment by examiners with different levels of ultrasound experience. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A total of 105 ultrasound images from three different groups of ovarian lesions (malignancies, functional cysts, and dermoid cysts) were evaluated using ATBA and by a total of 36 examiners with four different levels of experience (9 junior trainees, 8 senior trainees, 11 senior gynecologists, and 8 experts). Cohen's κ, Youden's indices, and the sensitivity and specificity of ATBA and of each observer were calculated for every subgroup of ovarian lesions. RESULTS: ATBA classified 78 of the 105 masses correctly (κ = 0.62) - results that were significantly better than those of the junior and senior trainees (p = 0.02 and p < 0.01), while differences from the group of level II examiners did not reach statistical significance (p = 0.27). The best diagnostic performance (κ = 0.70) was obtained by the group of expert level III ultrasonographers. The best classification rates overall, including both ATBA and subjective assessments, were achieved in the detection of functional cysts (Youden's indices from 0.73 to 0.85), while the poorest diagnostic performance was obtained for the classification of dermoid cysts (Youden's indices from 0.28 to 0.55). CONCLUSION: ATBA showed a significantly better diagnostic performance than observers with low or medium levels of experience, emphasizing its potential value for training purposes and in providing additional diagnostic assistance for inexperienced observers.
abstract_ja: 目的:卵巣腫瘤の超音波画像における新しい自動テクスチャ解析アルゴリズム(ATBA)の診断精度を評価し、経験レベルの異なる検者による主観的評価と比較すること。材料と方法:悪性腫瘍、機能性嚢胞、皮様嚢腫の3群からなる卵巣病変の超音波画像105例を、ATBAおよび4段階の経験レベルの計36名の検者(若手研修医9名、上級研修医8名、上級婦人科医11名、専門医8名)で評価した。Cohenのκ、Youden指数、各群の感度および特異度を算出した。結果:ATBAは105例中78例を正しく分類した(κ=0.62)。これは若手および上級研修医より有意に良好であった(p=0.02、p<0.01)が、レベルII検者群との差は有意ではなかった(p=0.27)。最良の診断精度(κ=0.70)は専門的な超音波検査医(レベルIII)群で得られた。ATBAと主観的評価を含めた全体の最良分類率は機能性嚢胞の検出で得られ(Youden指数0.73〜0.85)、皮様嚢腫の分類で最も低かった(Youden指数0.28〜0.55)。結論:ATBAは経験の少ない検者より有意に良好な診断精度を示し、教育目的および経験の浅い検者への診断補助としての潜在的価値が示された。
